items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: So therefore he had a fine band, Jeffrey Tavern.

ctx.x: What did Huey Swift play like?

Oh he was a trumpet player, a very good musician. Not much on jazz though, but he had, he surrounded himself, some very good fine musician. So therefore he had a fine band, Jeffrey Tavern. Yeah. He had some band out there.
